If you haven't ordered the iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max yet, you may have to wait until October to receive it. Here is the latest news on the delivery times for iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders.

New iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders are mostly expected to ship in October

Apple opened pre-orders for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max over the weekend, and just a few days after launch, delivery times have largely slipped into October.

The earliest pre-orders will arrive on Friday, September 18, and the first batch of stock will also be available in Apple Stores that day.

However, as of today, you'll see the following delivery estimates at the US Apple Store:

  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: All colors and storage capacities won't be available until October 6 to 13
  • iPhone 18 Pro: All colors and storage capacities won't be available until September 29 to October 6

So if you want to buy the iPhone 18 Pro Max, expect to wait close to a month to receive it.

The situation for the smaller-screen iPhone 18 Pro is slightly better, but unless they hit their initial targets, you'll likely have to wait until October to receive it.

It's still too early to judge how the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are selling overall, and it's unclear how much impact the smaller-screen flagship model will have on sales this year. However, delivery times have already slipped by several weeks, which seems to be a positive sign.

Have you already pre-ordered the iPhone 18 Pro, or are you waiting for the iPhone Duo or not planning to upgrade? Feel free to leave a comment and let us know.
